Glycolytic/Control.rationale: baseline viability, the constraint that all phenotypes stay under 2% death untreated. 0 deaths at 1e6; the true basal rate is unmeasured.

Glycolytic/RSL3.rationale: the manuscript's own selectivity constraint -- RSL3 is supposed to spare this phenotype. 0 deaths at 1e6 AND at 1e8, so the bound is already 3e-8.

PersisterNrf2/Control.rationale: exactly 1 death in 1e6 -- sitting on the resolution limit, where a single event carries a Poisson interval spanning two orders of magnitude.
